usage.callShape: POST https://blockrun.ai/api/v1/chat/completions with JSON body {model, messages[]} (OpenAI chat-completions shape)
usage.outputShape: body.choices[0].message.content (assistant text); token accounting at body.usage
quirks: OpenAI-compatible chat-completions API; pass model slug to pick tier (e.g. openai/gpt-5.5)
Response 'model' field echoes a dated build (e.g. gpt-5.5-2026-04-23), not the request slug
Price varies by tokens/model; a tiny 'hello' call cost ~$0.026 USDC on Base
usage.guide: POST to https://blockrun.ai/api/v1/chat/completions an OpenAI-style chat body: {"model":"openai/gpt-5.5","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"..."}]}. Payment is x402 USDC on Base, charged per call by token usage (no API key needed). Read the assistant reply from body.choices[0].message.content. Swap the model slug to access other GPT-5 tiers (5.4, 5.3, mini/nano, codex).
